findings.correction: There has been no betrayal, and we aren’t going to die. Least of all to trash like you.
findings.current: I have never betrayed anyone, and there’s no reason for me to die. Especially not at the hands of trash like you.
findings.defect: 죽을 일도 없다 is a claim that they will not die, not that they lack a reason to die; the English turns swagger into justification.
findings.rationale: Gwak is rejecting Hyuk’s threat, not arguing that death would be unwarranted.
findings.source: 배신한 적도, 죽을 일도 없다. 네놈들 따위한테는 더더욱.

findings.correction: I was scared shitless. The more I shrank back, the more triumphant Gwak Jun looked.
findings.current: My nerves were burning. The more intimidated I became, the more triumphant Gwak Jun looked.
findings.defect: 똥줄이 활활 탄다 is crude comic terror (scared shitless), not burning nerves, which can read as anger.
findings.rationale: Narrator register and the intimidation beat both depend on bodily fear, not taut nerves.
findings.source: 똥줄이 활활 탄다. 내가 위축될수록 곽준은 기세등등해졌다.

findings.defect: 눈을 부릅떴다 is eyes going wide in shock after being stopped, not a glare.
findings.rationale: The beat is disbelief at the order to stay still, not hostility toward Taekyung.

findings.correction: This reaction was odd. Hyuk Mujin thought it over for a moment, then tossed out a single remark.
findings.current: Hyuk Mujin fell silent for a moment, thinking hard. Then he tossed out a single remark.
findings.defect: Omits the narrator’s cue that this reaction is odd, which sets up Hyuk’s punchline that the First Rate enemies will die.
findings.rationale: The peculiar pause is the joke’s setup; dropping it flattens characterization.
findings.source: 이번 반응은 묘하다. 잠깐 곰곰이 생각에 잠겨 있던 혁무진이 한마디를 툭, 던졌다.

findings.correction: Hyuk Mujin, his face startled, propped me up.
findings.defect: 부축했다 is bracing/supporting him as strength leaves; 화들짝 놀란 얼굴 is omitted and replaced with a catch.
findings.rationale: Logout collapse is a loss of bodily control, not a fall into someone’s arms; Hyuk’s panic is on his face.
findings.source: 혁무진이 화들짝 놀란 얼굴로 나를 부축했다.

findings.correction:
**Reward:** EXP and Fame
>
> **Chain Quest**
>
> **Failure:** Death

Keep Failure visually a sibling field of Grade/Restriction/Objective/Reward, not a child of Chain Quest.
findings.defect: Failure: Death is a field of the current quest; the English heading stack makes it look like the unnamed chain quest’s fail condition.
findings.rationale: 사망 is this quest’s failure, listed after an unlabeled 연계 퀘스트 tag, not assigned to a follow-up quest.
findings.source:
보상 : 경험치와 명성
 연계 퀘스트
실패 : 사망

findings.correction: That was a strange battle cry. No, wait. Wasn’t that an animal cry?
findings.current:
That was a strange battle cry.

No, wait. Wasn’t that a cry of some sort?
findings.defect: 울음소리 is an animal cry/wail, the setup for the water deer; “a cry of some sort” is vague.
findings.rationale: The gag turns on realizing the charge-cry is a beast’s bleat.
findings.source: 함성치곤 독특한데. 아니, 저건 울음소리 아닌가.

findings.correction: Every time Taekyung’s spear moved, blood spurted and his subordinates went down.
findings.current: Every time Taekyung’s spear moved, blood spurted and one of Gwak’s subordinates fell.
findings.defect: 수하들이 is plural; “one of” shrinks each spear motion to a single casualty.
findings.rationale: Gwak is watching repeated drops, not a one-to-one count.
findings.source: 놈의 창이 움직일 때마다 피가 솟구치고 수하들이 쓰러진다.

findings.defect: 왜요 asks why he is being called, not an attentive “Yes?”
findings.rationale: Hyuk’s reply is a puzzled prompt, matching 왜요.

findings.correction: Of the ten or so subordinates caught in One Flash, he was the only one who managed even a sound.
findings.current: Of the dozen or so subordinates caught in One Flash, he was the only one who managed to make even a sound.
findings.defect: 십여 명 is ten-odd, not “a dozen or so.”
findings.rationale: Localized quantity change without source support.
findings.source: 일섬에 휘말린 십여 명의 부하 중 목소리라도 남긴 이는 그가 유일했다.

findings.correction: Keep the line and add a first-use footnote: Golden Sore Medicine is a salve for blade wounds.
findings.current: If you’re going to kill him gently, you might as well say you’ll coat your spearhead with Golden Sore Medicine and stab him.
findings.defect: Unlisted 금창약 is calqued with no note; the joke needs that it is a wound-healing salve.
findings.rationale: Without the healing sense, coating a spearhead is opaque rather than sarcastic.
findings.source: 살살 죽인다니, 차라리 창날에 금창약을 바르고 찌른다고 하십쇼.

summary: Several major fidelity issues: Gwak’s death-claim is softened into motive, Taekyung’s crude fear idiom is recast as nerves, Hyuk’s shocked beats are flattened or dropped, and the logout catch is rewritten as a grab. Quest-window hierarchy and a few local quantities/register points also slip.
